name: Honda Magna V45 / V65
engine: 748 or 1098 cc liquid-cooled V4, four carbs, shaft drive
intro: Honda's early V4 cruisers. Fast and smooth. Early engines are known for cam and rocker wear.

add.title: Inspect the cams and rockers
add.instructions: With the valve covers off, look at the cam lobes and rocker faces for pitting and wear. Check the oil feed to the heads.
add.reason: Premature cam and rocker wear is the best-known problem on first-generation Honda V4s.

H: Warm the engine fully before riding hard. Low oil flow to the top end at low rpm is part of the cam wear story.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Cam wear
known.what: Early V4 engines wore cam lobes, rocker faces and cam bearings prematurely.
